title: Episode About the Slaughter of Jassu (Jassu Rai)

blocks.text: This transition page first completes the Bhai Taru Singh sequence by recalling the destruction that overtook the persecuting household of Khan Bahadur. It then turns sharply into a new political landscape following the death of Nawab Khan Bahadur Zakariya Khan.

Lahore and Multan became contested centers of succession, and Shah Nawaz seized power while rivals struggled for control. In that unstable court, the old hostility to the Sikhs quickly returned under new hands.

The page therefore sets up the campaign of oppression on the Singhs led by Shah Nawaz and enforced through officials such as Lakhpat Rai and Jaspat Rai. What follows is not an isolated quarrel, but a new round of organized state violence against the Khalsa.
